description: How a product video from make_product_video, or from a step after one, is going: queued, in_progress, ready or failed, with why and whether its credits were refunded. Once ready, it has after_steps, the steps it offers next with their prices in credits. Each ready video's download_url is made new in every answer and works for the next hour: its download_expires_in_seconds is the seconds it has left as that answer is made. For a later download, call get_product_video again for a new link. Free.
name: get_product_video
